blocks.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot Hansarp credit fader anchors: retain native backdrop stacking under the visible controls.
blocks.rationale: The source generic link hover/focus rule transforms and raises the invisible native fader close anchor over modal controls. W13 removed this block when re-certification against the then-current Wikidot snapshot showed no A/B need on the target page; the Sigma-10 campaign frame then failed all three credit.otherwise back-control-click rows (desktop/mobile/narrow-mobile) because the hovered fader anchor (full-viewport under the saved Credit cascade) intercepts the return-credits click. Freeze-3 (OD-T2 class B) restores the block verbatim (sha256 identical to the pre-removal text). The Freeze-3 toggle probe on the Sigma-10 acceptance frame reproduces the audit failure on the block-less candidate (hover raises the anchor: transform matrix(1.04856,0.0549528,...) with z-index 2, click times out at 1440/390/320) and passes the full open-otherwise/scroll/back-click/return sequence with the block restored at all three viewports.

blocks.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot Hansarp history options: size the history option tracks fluidly so the form fits the mobile viewport.
blocks.rationale: The composed history rule sizes the option cell tracks as repeat(3,3rem 1fr); on the JP frame the fixed tracks push the history form past the mobile viewport (document 472px at 390px in the acceptance frame; the frozen real-content A/B measured the candidate at 404px against the native 390px, G2-25). The fluid repeat(3,1fr) sizing — the same correction the BHL family carries for this form (Q1-9/D1) — fits the form at 390px and gives the two-row option layout of the JP target at desktop widths (W13 delta receipt). Freeze-3 (OD-T2 class H): a 5px narrow-mobile (320px) residual remained because the 1fr tracks cannot shrink below their min-content; bounding the same tracks as repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) clears the residual in both shells (document 325px -> 320px, table 312.5px -> 288px, form scrollWidth 309 -> 288) with 390px geometry unchanged (Freeze-3 delta receipt).

blocks.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot Hansarp search: reveal the collapsed query input while the search control is hovered or keyboard-focused.
blocks.rationale: The theme collapses the header search form to an icon box with the query input at display:none; the earlier reveal adaptation was removed in the authority cleanup, so the JP frame's search control cannot be typed into at all (defect Q2-6; the Sigma frame shows a 250px form with a visible input). This block restores the reveal on hover and on focus-within, with an 8rem input width (without a width the revealed input stays 27px at desktop). W13 delta receipt: input display none -> inline-block at 128px on hover at 1440px and 390px. Freeze-3 (OD-T2 class G): the in-flow 8rem reveal overflowed the tablet/mobile/narrow viewports by 29/41/43px in both shells because the revealed form is centered on the 23.4px search box (form centre approx viewport - 35.5px at <=768px), so the input's right edge lands at centre + 64px. At <=1024px the revealed input now grows leftwards instead: the form becomes the positioning context and the input is absolutely placed ending 1.75rem before the form's right edge (clear of the submit control), keeping the full 8rem usable width with measured document overflow 0px at 768/390/320 in both shells (Freeze-3 delta receipt). Desktop in-flow geometry is unchanged.

blocks.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot Hansarp navigation labels: keep top-bar labels unbroken on narrow viewports.
blocks.rationale: JP top-bar labels fragment mid-word in the mobile/narrow bars (Q1-2 carrier; the data label breaks across lines in the W11 frames). word-break:keep-all is the standard JP label treatment: labels take their full width instead of fragmenting. blocks.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot redtape mobile submenu: list the mobile submenu in a single column like the target menu instead of a two-column grid with a dangling empty cell.
blocks.rationale: The inherited BHL mobile rule lays the top-bar submenu out as a two-column grid (grid-template-columns:repeat(2,50%)); the SCP-JP target menu has 17 items, so the grid leaves a dangling empty translucent cell at the bottom right (defect Q1-9), while the target Sigma menu is a single-column list. The same-target delta receipt shows this block restores a single column at 320/390px and leaves the desktop submenu template unchanged.

blocks.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot redtape credit heritage: give the heritage rating module the dark pill ground of the target composition so its label stays readable in the credit modal.
blocks.rationale: In the credit modal the heritage rating module box computes to the theme background (rgb(252,252,252)) because --rating-module-bg-color resolves to --swatch-background (white monochrome), while the target composition shows the heritage module as a dark pill and the campaign pilot shows redtape label text failing against the white box (defect Q1-7; the F5 comparison in the W02 triage found the box background itself divergent, so this is not the F5 identical state). The same-target delta receipt shows this block gives the modal module the theme dark accent ground (rgb(70,13,13)) with the on-dark text color (label contrast 8.9) and leaves the page-level heritage module unchanged. The pilot cascade balance differs from the fixture frame on the label color source, so the block sets both the ground and the text variables; full verification at the Sigma-9 recapture. W13 (G2-13): the nested .page-rate-widget-box kept its own light ground inside the darkened module, leaving the rate segment white-on-white in the modal; the block now also clears the widget ground to transparent and sets its text to the on-dark color (W13 delta receipt: widget background rgb(252,252,252) -> transparent, rate-points color -> rgb(252,252,252) on the dark pill; screenshot-verified).

blocks.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot redtape dialog headings: keep dialog body headings on the dialog text color so they stay readable on the white dialog ground.
blocks.rationale: Two redtape-authored choices collide in dialogs: its own owindow rule forces the dialog ground white, while its variable block sets --swatch-text-tertiary-color to the white accent, and the shared BHL rule colors dialog body headings rgb(var(--modal-body-header-txt)) = the tertiary color — measured heading rgb(244,244,244) on white, contrast 1.1 (defect Q1-8; the BHL reference computes a dark heading at 17.79). Redefining --modal-body-header-txt to the dialog own text color (bright accent) inside the owindow scope restores a readable heading (measured 5.9) with body text unchanged.

blocks.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot BHL credit otherwise correction: keep the back link on one line in the otherwise credit dialog.
blocks.rationale: In the otherwise credit dialog the back link (戻る) is a flex item beside the credit label pseudo-element; the row shrinks it to one glyph width (18px), so the two glyphs stack (defect Q1-1, BHL family). The same-target delta receipt shows the link at two lines and the row at 47.5px tall without the correction, and one line (row 28px) with white-space:nowrap and flex-shrink:0 on the link, with no collateral geometry change at 320-1440px.
